props.name: autoFocus
props.description:
Whether to focus the first empty slot after mounting, or the last slot when all are filled.
Focus is skipped when the control is disabled, and `autoFocusDelay` postpones it.

props.name: autoFocusDelay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds between mount and focusing. Only used with `autoFocus`.

props.name: autoSubmit
props.description:
Whether to call `requestSubmit()` on the owning form, which runs native validation and
fires a `submit` event, right after `onComplete`. The form is found through `form`, the
inputs, or the closest ancestor `<form>`; nothing happens without one.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Initial value for uncontrolled usage, as the joined string. Also the value restored when the
owning form is reset.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: form
props.description:
The `id` of the `<form>` the control belongs to, for a control rendered outside that form.
It is set on the slot inputs and on the hidden input that submits the joined value under `name`.

props.name: groupSize
props.description:
Group inputs by inserting a separator between groups: a number for groups of that size,
or an array of consecutive group sizes.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's main focusable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to
with `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's related parts (hidden
input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it unique on the page.

props.name: inputMode
props.description:
The virtual keyboard hint applied to the inputs and hidden input.
Overrides the `inputMode` derived from `validationType`.

props.name: inputsRef
props.description:
Receives the array of the slot `<input>` elements, in order, after mount and whenever
`length` changes. It is called with an empty array on cleanup.

props.name: length
props.description: The number of single-character inputs, at least 1. Longer values are truncated to it.

props.name: mask
props.description: Whether to hide the entered characters by rendering the slots as `type="password"` inputs.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: normalizeValue
props.description:
Normalizes a proposed value after `validationType` filtering; the result is
filtered again and clamped to `length`. Applied to string `value`/`defaultValue`
and to typed, pasted, or autofilled text.
Should be idempotent, since it may run on the same value more than once.

props.name: onBlur
props.description:
Native blur event when focus leaves the pin input group, called before the `Field` blur
notification.

props.name: onComplete
props.description:
Called with the joined string when every slot is filled. For controlled values it fires once
the value is actually applied. Runs before the form is submitted when `autoSubmit` is set.

props.name: onFocus
props.description:
Native focus event when focus enters the pin input group from outside, called before the
`Field` focus notification.

props.name: onFocusIn
props.description:
Native focusin event for every slot focus, including moves between slots. Called before
`onFocus`.

props.name: onFocusOut
props.description:
Native focusout event for every slot blur, including moves between slots. Called before
`onBlur`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called whenever the entered characters change, with the joined string of at most `length`
characters. A cleared middle slot keeps its position in the UI but is dropped from the
string: clearing the middle of `'123'` reports `'13'`.

props.name: onValueInvalid
props.description:
Called when entered text is refused: a typed, pasted, or autofilled batch containing
characters dropped by `validationType` or `normalizeValue` (`reason: 'patternMismatch'`),
or a paste with more valid characters than `length` (`reason: 'tooLong'`). Accepted
characters from the same input are still applied and reported through `onValueChange`; a
paste that breaks both rules calls it once per reason. Does not fire for whitespace and
dashes, which are stripped silently. It cannot cancel the input and is unrelated to the
native `invalid` event.
examples:
import { PinInput } from 'moraine'

<PinInput
  validationType="number"
  onValueInvalid={({ value, reason }) => console.warn(reason, value)}
/>

props.name: otp
props.description:
Whether to enable One-Time Password autofill by setting `autocomplete="one-time-code"` on
the first slot, and on the hidden input when `name` is set. A received code is spread across the slots.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown in empty slots that are not focused, typically one character such as `○`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref callback or variable that receives the root `<div>` container element.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: separatorRender
props.description:
Component that renders the separator content between groups, replacing the default `•`.
It receives the `index` of the input it follows and only appears when `groupSize` creates groups.
examples: import { PinInput } from 'moraine' –} />

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: translations
props.description:
Localized message overrides for this pin input instance. `input` builds the `aria-label` of
each slot from its 1-based `index` and the `length`.

props.name: validationType
props.description:
Which characters a slot accepts: `'number'` digits `0-9`, `'alpha'` letters `a-z` / `A-Z`,
`'alphanumeric'` both, `'text'` any non-whitespace character. Rejected characters are dropped
and reported to `onValueInvalid`. It also picks the default `inputMode` (`numeric` for
`'number'`, `text` otherwise).

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled value as the joined string (`'123456'`). `undefined` leaves the input
uncontrolled. The value is filtered by `validationType` and truncated to `length`; update it
from `onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the component.
